assumptions: Checked formula in BrowserHelperEntry: PermissionReconciles = reconcile.weakFair(s).implies( not(s.permission).leadsTo(s.permission or (s.entry == "none" and s.full == "none")))
The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.

limitations: The host must stop invoking plugin operations after destruction.
WindowManager and IME operations are modeled as atomic main-thread actions. Window creation refusal is modeled. Removal failures and device-level attachment behavior require Android validation.
This covers helper view custody. The browser surface, docking policy and task authority are separate state owners.
